name: dromaios
description: An in-browser emulation platform for exploring how computers work.

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; for (const path of ['dist', 'src/machines/generated', 'src/components/cpus/generated']) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.check:src: npm run generate:cpus && npm run generate:machines && tsc --project tsconfig.src.json
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run check:src && tsc
